mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT INNER_LIST.*, ROWNUM AS RNUM FROM ( SELECT c.cno, c.ctype, c.cstock, c.mno, c.bno, b.bname, b.bprice, b.bimg, c.pno, p.pname, p.pprice, p.pimg, p.ptype FROM cart c LEFT JOIN book b ON c.bno = b.bno LEFT JOIN pass p ON c.pno = p.pno WHERE c.mno = #{mno} ORDER BY c.cno DESC ) INNER_LIST ) WHERE RNUM BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow}

SELECT c.cno, c.ctype, c.cstock, c.mno, c.bno, b.bname, b.bprice, b.bimg, c.pno, p.pname, p.pprice, p.pimg, p.ptype FROM cart c LEFT JOIN book b ON c.bno = b.bno LEFT JOIN pass p ON c.pno = p.pno WHERE c.mno = #{mno} ORDER BY c.cno DESC
